videos.overview: KWONG has a traffic accident and is sent to hospital. Not until then does he know that he has chronic kidney failure. A patient named Albert, despite his old age, is very lustful. He is interested in SARAH when he sees how much she appreciates his red wine, which not many people do. Albert can see that HENRY likes SARAH. He points to HENRY that he is no match to SARAH. HENRY is angry. SARAH has dinner with MC and YEUNG. During the dinner, she advises MC not to fight with MARTHA in court for YEUNG’s custody. MC does not listen, nevertheless. NELSON plays bowling with FRANCES. He feels sick in the middle of the course because of the noisy environment there. PHOEBE launches a fund-raising activity for KWONG so that he can afford his medical fees. She also invites the press to have interviews with him in the hospital. PAUL is displeased with all these. LING contacts PAUL and offers a kidney donation to KWONG. KWONG tells down her kindness.… ...

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: FRANCES and PAUL decide not deceive themselves. They propose to split up with NELSON and PHOEBE respectively. MC does not think that he stands a chance of wining his son’s custody. SARAH comforts him. Although MARTHA knows it very well that YEUNG is very close to MC, she stills believes that her relationship with YEUNG will improve. MC reproaches her for not respecting YEUNG’s own will. BETSY has made an erroneous diagnosis and is reprimanded by MC. BETSY believes that MC, who has been troubled by his family, was venting his anger on her. HENRY does not think so. CHRIS is shopping for computer games when he comes across GRACE. The two has an excellent rapport with each other. SARAH is very much annoyed that ALBERT is running after her. HENRY offers to give her some help. FRANCES and PAUL enjoy their single lives again. HENRY learns that BETSY has applied for a transfer to the Cardiac Department.… ...

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: KAREN confirms that she has contracted the venereal disease from CHEUNG, her husband. She forgives him nevertheless for the sake of their son though her heart aches. Her heart is broken later when she discovers that her husband is messes around with women again. The relationship of YEUNG and Martha has improved. MC feels a sense of loss. CHRIS is inspired by some disabled athletes and their families. He decides not to escape from reality by playing computer games anymore. YEUNG is suspected to have inherited anemia. MC therefore doubts that YEUNG is not his biological son. KAREN has received quite a few complaints from patients recently. BRYAN defends her and has an argument with AMY. HENRY and Albert go fishing together so as to settle things for SARAH. They compare fishing to chasing girls and have a good chat. No sooner has CHRIS been home than ANSON embraces him in tears.… ...

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: FRANCES, who has been traveling for a while, has returned to Hong Kong. ANSON is not feeling well. Nevertheless, she insists on delivering a woman’s baby. As a result, she loses her own child. This comes as a big blow to CHRIS. KAREN decides to divorce CHEUNG and immerses herself in work. After meeting with a bone cancer patient of SARAH’s, PAUL has a new light in life and decides to go out with FRANCES. BETSY reports duty at the Cardiac Department. MC tests her with some questions, and is dissatisfied with her performance. MC has been granted YEUNG’s custody at last. He, nevertheless, he lets YEUNG go to the States with his mother believing he will have better treatment for his problem there. MARTHA is a bit surprised that he has found out already that YEUNG is not his biological son and by his reaction. Although MC knows perfectly well how SARAH sees him and HENRY, he still tries his best hoping to win her heart.… ...

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: MC, knowing that PAUL has been very down because of PHOEBE’s illness, goes and cheers him up. BETSY can see that MC does not trust her. HENRY gives her some words of consolations, only to be accused of leading to her present situation. The workmen at the furniture store of GRACE’s family are going to CHRIS’ place to repair his bed. GRACE goes with them. HENRY is at a bookshop when he meets SUE, who sent the victim of a car accident to hospital the other day. PAUL returns to his car to take something, leaving FRANCES alone in the bar. When he returns, he is shocked to see that something has happened in the bar. He tells FRANCES how worried he is. MC sees HENRY and SUE together. HENRY worries that he will tell SARAH about this. PHOEBE is standing dangerously at the roof top. PAUL manages to persuade her into giving up her suicidal thought. BETSY is home. She discovers some traces which suggest that HENRY has taken a woman home.… ...

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: ANSON tests CHRIS’ reaction to the earring. When she knows that it belongs to GRACE, she cannot help but suspects that CHRIS and GRACE are having an affair. SARAH accompanies FRANCES to buy a silk scarf for PHOEBE, during which SARAH discloses her secret in mind to FRANCES. KWONG goes to the hospital for dialysis; there he hears that PHOEBE has cancer and that PAUL is the doctor in charge. He therefore advises PAUL to be careful in handling his sentiment. FRANCES is unhappy to see PHOEBE make use of her identity as a patient to satisfy her own need and that she claims that she is going to win PAUL’s sympathy. After knowing about SARAH’s illness, TY tells her that he will re-arrange her jobs. He also advises her to accept her friends’ support. MC teases at HENRY, who is being uneasy. BETSY discovers that her name has been crossed out from the list of surgeons who will take part in surgeries. She goes to reason with MC.… ...

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: BETSY sees SARAH walking out from MC’s dormitory. When she later knows that HENRY has confessed everything to SARAH, she concludes that SARAH is revenging HENRY. PAUL takes some drug to PHOEBE, only to see her jumping off the building to end her life. MC comes across an old friend of his, after which he determines to accomplish something in his career. He has decided too to firstly turn to BETSY. Noticing that PAUL is upset for PHOEBE’s death, FRANCES decides to keep the conversation between her and PHOEBE a secret. ANSON is handling a pregnant woman’s complaint when ROSANNA behaves rather weirdly. GRACE, who sees this, is worried. AMY tries to kill herself with pills. Luckily, she is sent to hospital before it is too late. BRYAN tells her that he has left his lover and asks for her forgiveness. AMY, nevertheless, has made up her mind to leave him. It turns out that ROSANNA is the lover of BRYAN.… ...

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: BETSY visits ANGUS and gets to taste the organic fruits that he planted himself. FRANCES goes to seek PAUL and SARAH’s advice on her working as a Forensic Pathologist again. DEREK gets ANGUS’ address from BETSY and pays him a visit. The two are reconciled with each other. CHRIS asks BETSY about what happened in the canteen the other day. She reveals her feelings for him. CHRIS is rather shocked; he begs GRACE not to tease him in front of ANSON. GRACE fears that she cannot hold her love to CHRIS any longer. She goes to ROSANNA to pour her heart out. FRANCES is stunned to learn that SARAH’s cancer has recurred. She makes up her mind to go back to Forensic Pathology after the news. KWONG’s condition has turned bad. He is hospitalized and put on the kidney transplantation wait list. ANSON can see that GRACE is very excited on seeing that CHRIS has got the same cell phone strap as hers.… ...

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: PAUL tries to persuade NING into changing her mind, fearing that KWONG may not be able to make it to the next opportunity. PAUL has found out that NING refused to donate her husband’s kidney when she knew that KWONG is the beneficiary. He later gets the truth from KWONG. A youngster has killed himself, leaving behind a note that accuses SUM or sexually attacked him. FRANCES, nevertheless, does not find any evidence on the dead body. HENRY goes to SARAH to give her a wedding invitation of a mutual friend of theirs. He grabs the opportunity to ask her out but is turned down. Following the advice of ROSANNA, GRACE tells CHRIS frankly that she understands his difficulty. CHRIS is relieved, and he tells her the problem that he and ANSON have to face. She gives him some consolation; CHRIS is touched and kisses her. The two have a car accident outside a love hotel. CHRIS explains to ANSON at once.… ...

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: SARAH announces her illness and her dating with HENRY to her colleagues. ROSANNA advises GRACE not to see CHRIS for the time being so as to test his love for ANSON. NING goes to see KWONG; he apologizes to her. It turns out that PHOEBE has revealed in her last work that KWONG has been feeling guilty for his mistake and he regrets not having the opportunity to say sorry to NING’s husband, who is a good friend of his. PAUL sighs as NING’s husband eventually dies. PAUL discovers that SUM’s wife, YUNG, is mentally tense. FRANCES explains that this shows that she is guilty for what she has done in fighting for a pardon for her husband. A patient of BETSY’s refuses to be treated by her because of her mistake in the past. MC, who witnesses this, gives the patient a lesson. Under the arrangement of MC, BETSY and TY meet with each other. BETSY refuses to accept TY’s gift because of old grudge.… ...

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: YUNG tries to take her life by burning charcoals. After knowing that FRANCES has persuaded YUNG into testifying against SUM, PAUL accuses FRANCES of pushing YUNG even though she knows that YUNG is troubled mentally. FRANCES is speechless. TY promotes MC. Thinking that MC got the promotion because of her, BETSY asks MC to treat her to dinner. SUM is acquitted. The family members of the victim push him onto the ground in anger outside the court. SUM, who has foam at his mouth, is rushed to the hospital. PAUL finds that the tumor in his brain has burst and that an operation is needed immediately. Unfortunately, SUM dies. TY recommends MC to conduct a bypass operation for Professor TIN, who is a famous cardiac surgeon. MC needs BETSY to look after TIN after work. She is upset that she cannot take part in a Halloween party because of this. PAUL is shocked to hear the result of the inquest of the coroner on SUM’s death.… ...

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: MC accuses HENRY of failing to work according to regulations. BETSY fears that HENRY’s prospect would be affected. She asks TY who should be responsible for this when home. Some passengers of a flight to Hong Kong have contracted contagious Monkey Pox. TY instructs HENRY to report to him at once if suspected cases are found. NELSON has come to Hong Kong for a medical conference. He takes the opportunity to pay FRANCES a visit. ANSON forces CHRIS to face squarely on GRACE. Instead of blaming NING for her refusal to donate her husband’s kidney, KWONG is grateful to her. FRANCES takes a pregnant woman to the hospital. As a result, she has to cancel her meeting with PAUL. SARAH is dumbfounded when she knows that HENRY is aware of her cancer illness. FRANCES goes to the countryside alone for photo-taking. She is robbed and tied up. NELSON has a fever and is sent to hospital.… ...

videos.title: Episode 39
